name: Markdown Editor
description: Write and preview Markdown with live rendering, syntax highlighting, and CommonMark-compliant export options for U.S. writers, students, and developers.
longDescription: Markdown Editor provides a distraction-free writing environment with live preview. Supports CommonMark specification-compliant Markdown (https://spec.commonmark.org/) including tables, task lists, footnotes, and math. Syntax highlighting in the editor. Export to HTML, PDF, or raw Markdown. Word count and reading time built in. Works instantly in any modern browser — Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, iOS — with zero sign-up and $0 cost.
pricingDetails: Core editor completely free — $0 cost versus $2/month single-purpose markdown subscriptions. No account required. All processing happens in your browser.
features: Live preview with CommonMark-compliant Markdown output
Syntax highlighting for code blocks and inline formatting
Tables, task lists, footnotes, and math support
Export to HTML, PDF, or raw Markdown
Word count and reading time for U.S. content creators
Offline-capable after first load — zero sign-up required
useCases: U.S. technical documentation and README writing
Blog post drafting with CommonMark-compliant output
API documentation for American developers and students
Note taking and academic writing without subscription costs
